items.description: Assumption 1 and the forbidden_actions entry both state the conventions doc bans inline network I/O outright and attribute the word 'forbidden' to it. The doc says 'Queue anything that performs network I/O, UNLESS the call is to a service inside the same cluster and the caller already holds a deadline' — a conditional rule with an explicit escape hatch, and the word forbidden appears nowhere.

Assumption 2 says buildReport violates the ban. It is a same-cluster call taking a caller-held deadline, which is exactly the documented exception, so it complies today and step 1's whole rationale collapses.
